name: Tinker: Gear Grind deals damage and generates Scrap without a 1H melee weapon (#13716)
contract: Gear Grind (680975 -> 681245 -> 504594) replaces Makeshift Dynamite (572888 rank 7) with a 1.5 s ranged channel (DmgClass 3, EquippedItemClass -1) that triggers 4 ticks of Gear Grind Damage (505160, 0/500/1000/1500 ms via SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD), each dealing Stormstrike/Nature damage (Spell.dbc: BaseLevel 27, MaxLevel 0, BasePoints 73, DieSides 9, RealPointsPerLevel 5.0 -> 339..347 at level 80, plus 0.16*RAP per 504594 tooltip, SchoolMask 9) and triggering Generate 1 Scrap (707476 -> +1 stack of 801816). Spell.dbc left stale 1H melee weapon requirements on 505160 (EquippedItemClass 2, EquippedItemInventoryTypeMask 2105344, SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_MAIN_HAND_WEAPON, DmgClass 2), so Spell::CheckItems rejected every triggered 505160 tick when the Tinker carried only a ranged weapon (or a 2H weapon), letting 504594 channel cleanly with 0 hits, 0 damage and 0 Scrap. A level 80 Human Tinker with starting main-hand weapon (431911) destroyed, zero-stat gun Old Blunderbuss (2508, item_template.sql) equipped, ranged_hit_rating 10000 (Unit::MeleeSpellHitResult uses RANGED_ATTACK for DmgClass 3), melee_crit_rating and ranged_crit_rating 10000 (505160 has IsRangedWeaponSpell()==false so Spell::m_attackType is BASE_ATTACK and Unit::SpellCritChanceDone reads PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE for deterministic 2.0x crits, Spell.cpp:606, Unit.cpp:1720-1761,10363-10380), and spell penetration aura 823764 casts 504594 while Grinding Gears (681245) is active against a stationary Harvest Golem (36, min_level_armor 528 -> 3.350% armor DR at level 80, 0.9665x). With base RAP 300..332 (+48.00..53.12) and Tinker PvE class tuning aura 887016 (-20% = 0.80x at level 80, Spell.dbc BaseLevel 10 MaxLevel 60 RealPointsPerLevel -0.4), 4 critical hits deal ~2394..2560 (bounded 2300..2650, rejecting doubled ~4850+ or non-crit ~1213..1280 damage), generate 4 Scrap stacks (801816), and consume 681245.
